articles.title: Slash the Guitarist Now Has a Snake Named After Him
articles.summary: Scientists discovered a new snake in New Guinea and named it Lielaphis slashi, after Guns N' Roses guitarist Slash — who has been a lifelong reptile fan. DNA and scale counts proved it was a brand-new species.

articles.title: Sweet Tooth, Big Brain: Fruit May Have Fueled Human Evolution
articles.summary: A new study suggests sugary foods like fruit and honey — not just meat — helped fuel the growth of the human brain. Early ancestors' brains were apple-sized; ours are five times heavier.

articles.title: Caltech Chip Redirects Light in 74 Quadrillionths of a Second
articles.summary: Caltech researchers built a nanoscale device that steers one light beam with another in just 74 femtoseconds — about the time light takes to cross a human hair. It could speed up communications and computing.
